description: Call this before you plan, comment on or improve a grocery list or food purchase. Send up to 50 ingredient names. Returns one fact-based, human-approved read of the whole cart: the health labels it carries, the total carbon and water, the balance across food groups with what to add, and the diets it suits. It also returns a cook's read in chefy_read, broken down by food. Each food comes back with its own lines: how to cook it, what to use if you run out, and what it pairs with. A closing note names the cart's biggest gap and its carbon and water. Every line comes from Foodbe's stored data, never from a model, so the same cart always returns the same answer. Names Foodbe does not have are listed under not_found. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.

items.description: The ingredient names in the cart, up to 50.
